description: The plot illustrates the results of the shared Top-6 routed experts in two independent samples of a task, with the x-axis representing the sample size on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 32 to 2^17, and labeled at intervals of 2^n (e.g., 2^5, 2^7, 2^9), and the y-axis showing the shared Top-6 routed experts averaged by model layers on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1. The plot contains multiple lines, each representing a different model layer, with varying colors, marker shapes, and line styles; however, the exact details of the lines are not specified, but they generally show an increasing trend as the sample size increases, with some lines starting at around 0.2-0.4 at a sample size of 32 and rising to approximately 0.8-1 at a sample size of 2^17.
